attributes.name: async
attributes.function: Specifies that the script is downloaded in parallel to parsing the page, and executed as soon as it is available (before parsing completes) (only for external scripts)

attributes.name: crossorigin
attributes.function: Sets the mode of the request to an HTTP CORS Request

attributes.name: defer
attributes.function: Specifies that the script is downloaded in parallel to parsing the page, and executed after the page has finished parsing (only for external scripts)

attributes.name: integrity
attributes.function: Allows a browser to check the fetched script to ensure that the code is never loaded if the source has been manipulated

attributes.name: nomodule
attributes.function: Specifies that the script should not be executed in browsers supporting ES2015 modules

attributes.name: referrerpolicy
attributes.values: no-referrer | no-referrer-when-downgrade | origin | origin-when-cross-origin | same-origin | strict-origin | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | unsafe-url
attributes.function: Specifies which referrer information to send when fetching a script

attributes.name: src
attributes.function: Specifies the URL of an external script file

attributes.name: type
attributes.function: Specifies the media type of the script
